title: The unprinted year, i
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Three weeks without a reader. The line is already looser. A strip about nothing — the dog, the fan, the heat — drawn as if someone would see it, which nobody will.

panels.composition: The bedroom in July heat. A box fan. WOOD on the floor with the pad. BARNABY flat in front of the fan, ears blowing.

characters.pose: flat in front of the fan

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, looser line than usual, a young man on a bedroom floor with a pad and a dog lying flat in front of a box fan with its ears blowing

panels.composition: The dog's face in the fan. Bliss.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, loose, close-up of a dog's face in front of a fan with its ears and jowls blown back

panels.composition: Wood moving the dog six inches so he can have the fan. The dog moving back.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, loose, a young man sliding a dog sideways away from a fan and the dog sliding back, no words

panels.composition: Both of them in front of the fan. Ears and hair. The pad on the floor, blank. The line in this strip is fatter than in May. Nobody will notice; nobody will see it.
panels.caption: Box 5.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, loose fat line, a young man and a dog side by side in front of a box fan with hair and ears blowing, a blank pad on the floor
image.notes: The arc's line loosens week by week. Here: fatter brush, less spotting. Caption 'Box 5.' on every unprinted strip.

art.line: brush-pen, loosening; fatter strokes; less spotting; no reader

notes: The first unprinted week in the book. The line already loosening. 'Box 5.'
